title: This $30 tool lets you compare 50+ AI models without paying for each one
excerpt: Streamline your AI workflow with this tool.
content_html:
TL;DR: Harness the power of over 50 AI models with this lifetime subscription to the AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan, on sale now for just $29.97 (reg. $499) through Oct. 11, with code SAVE10.

Credit: AskAnyModel

$29.97
$499 Save $469.03

Not every AI model gives you the same answer, which can make choosing the right one for each task a job all by itself. If you’re looking for an easier way to compare results without tab-hopping and paying for dozens of subscription fees, it’s time to try AskAnyModel AI. This unique tool lets you compare answers and replies from over 50 AI models, with unlimited chat and image generation.

Right now, you can lock in a lifetime subscription to AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan for only $29.97 until Oct. 11.

It’s time to stop second-guessing your AI results. This lifetime subscription to AskAnyModel AI makes your AI workflow more efficient — you won’t have to keep tabs on each individual model’s unique strengths or spend time hopping around from model to model.

With AskAnyModel AI, you can ask your question and see answers from six AI models of your choice simultaneously. This makes it easy to compare and find the best answer for your needs, from coding help and image generation to basic question answers.

AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan gives you unlimited use of non-flagship AI models. You’ll also have 500 premium monthly credits that give you access to 20 advanced models, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, and Perplexity, when you need more powerful answers.

You can swap between models mid-conversation. AskAnyModel AI even lets you work on different devices as long as you have access to a web browser.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get your own lifetime subscription to AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan for just $29.97 until Oct. 11.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
